roadmap.goal: Apply one workspace-name rule (trim, then non-empty, then no control characters from the exact D4 set, then at most 24 Unicode scalars) with one byte-identical copy at all four doors (instance-dashboard rename, first-run bootstrap claim, dashboard provisioning, foundry doctor provision-workspace), so every refusal states the same reason and leaves nothing behind, and every accepted name is stored trimmed.
roadmap.scenario_ownership_invariant: All 28 DISTILL acceptance scenarios (55 outline rows) are owned by exactly one step (01-01: 0 acceptance + 13 core unit tests, 01-02: 8 + 4 check-arch gold tests, 02-01: 5 + 2 check-arch gold tests, 03-01: 7, 04-01: 5, 05-01: 3). DELIVER un-pends a scenario only in the step that owns it, in the DISTILL order; scenarios 21-24 may already pass after 03-01 (OQ-D4) but stay @pending until 04-01, and the parity outlines 26-28 stay @pending until all four doors are done. Scaffold burn-down tracked via grep -cE '^[[:space:]]*@.*@pending' crates/foundry-acceptance/tests/features/instance-workspace-name-rule.feature, grep -n 'SCAFFOLD' crates/foundry-core/tests/workspace_name.rs and grep -n 'SCAFFOLD' xtask/src/check_arch.rs (workspace_name_one_source section).

phases.name: The rule as a core value object, composed by rename (US-WNR-01, D1-D6, DDD-1/2/3/4/12a/13)

steps.name: WorkspaceName core value object: D4 set, D3 copy
steps.description: Create the value object in crates/foundry-core (in lib.rs or a sibling module workspace_name.rs re-exported from lib.rs; crafter's choice), following the ProjectKey idiom: pub WORKSPACE_NAME_MAX_CHARS = 24; WorkspaceName with a private String field, try_new(raw: &str) -> Result<WorkspaceName, WorkspaceNameError>, as_str(), Display; WorkspaceNameError a flat Copy enum {Empty, ControlCharacter, TooLong} whose thiserror Display is the D3 copy verbatim ('Workspace name must not be empty' / 'Workspace name must not contain control characters' / 'Workspace name must be at most 24 characters'). try_new order (D5/DDD-2): str::trim, then empty, then the D4 predicate over the trimmed value, then chars().count() > 24. The D4 predicate is EXACTLY: char::is_control() (Cc: U+0000-001F, U+007F-009F), U+202A-202E, U+2066-2069, U+2028, U+2029; every other Cf (U+200B-200F, U+00AD, U+FEFF, U+206A-206F, variation selectors) is allowed. Then in crates/foundry-core/tests/workspace_name.rs delete mod scaffold, import from foundry_core, delete the SCAFFOLD header marker, and remove the 13 #[ignore]s one at a time (each test RED for the right reason before GREEN).
criteria: All 13 workspace_name tests (9 exact-example, 4 proptest) pass un-ignored; mod scaffold and every SCAFFOLD marker in that file are gone
Every DDD-13 boundary pair holds exactly: 24/25 ASCII and multi-byte, U+001F/0020, U+007E/007F, U+009F/00A0, U+2027/2028/2029/202A, U+202E/202F, U+2065/2066/2069/206A
Edge Unicode White_Space (TAB, LF, CR, U+0085, U+2028/2029, NBSP) is trimmed not refused; edge non-whitespace controls (U+0001, U+202E) are refused; ZWJ/ZWNJ/soft hyphen/U+FEFF accepted
Precedence is Empty, then ControlCharacter, then TooLong; each variant's to_string() equals its D3 string byte for byte
foundry-core keeps no I/O and no new dependency; workspace build, fmt, clippy -D warnings, check-arch and the default acceptance lane green
